name: cs2-nades
title: CS2 Nades
description: Smoke, molotov, flash and HE lineups for the Counter-Strike 2 Premier maps with videos, loaded live from csnades.gg
author: mendyka

commands.name: nades
commands.title: CS2 Nades
commands.description: Browse the lineups of a Premier map, see the lineup picture and play the video

preferences.name: onlyRecommended
preferences.title: Start Filter
preferences.label: Show only recommended lineups at start
preferences.description: Recommended lineups are the ones csnades.gg marks as the essentials for a map. Ctrl+Shift+E switches in the list.

preferences.name: inlineVideo
preferences.title: Video
preferences.label: Show the video in Raycast
preferences.description: Converts the lineup video into an animated GIF with ffmpeg (about 5 s per lineup, cached afterwards). Raycast cannot play videos itself.

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Path
preferences.description: Only needed if ffmpeg is installed somewhere unusual. Leave empty to find it automatically.
